title: Commercial Interior Design in Bratislava | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: Design of offices, salons, shops and boutiques: project, 3D visualisation and custom business furniture. Bratislava and Vienna, free consultation.

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) creates modern, functional, and individually designed commercial interiors. We develop spaces that strengthen brand identity, provide a comfortable environment for customers and employees, and make efficient use of every square meter.
We work with offices, retail stores, boutiques, beauty salons, barbershops, dental and medical practices, restaurants, cafés, hotels, showrooms, and other commercial spaces.

Conceptual Design We develop individual commercial interior concepts based on the nature of the business, brand identity, target audience, functional requirements, and characteristics of the property.
The interior becomes part of the company's visual identity and helps create a distinctive and recognizable brand environment.
Space Planning & Functional Zoning Efficient space planning is particularly important for commercial interiors.
We develop layouts based on business processes, customer and employee circulation, furniture and equipment placement, lighting, and required functional areas.
For offices, we design reception areas, meeting rooms, executive offices, workspaces, lounge areas, office kitchens, dining areas, and common spaces.
For stores and boutiques, we plan retail areas, displays, fitting rooms, checkout areas, storage systems, and customer circulation.
3D Commercial Interior Visualization We create photorealistic 3D visualizations that allow clients to see the future commercial interior before project implementation begins.
3D visualization demonstrates the layout, furniture, materials, colors, lighting, and decorative elements, helping to review and approve key design decisions in advance.
Materials & Finishes We select finishing materials based on the design concept, purpose of the space, intensity of use, practical requirements, and project budget.
For commercial interiors, particular attention is given to durability, ease of maintenance, and the ability of materials to maintain their appearance under intensive everyday use.
Commercial Lighting Design Lighting is an important part of commercial interior architecture.
Depending on the purpose of the space, we develop general, functional, accent, and decorative lighting scenarios.
Well-planned lighting helps create the right atmosphere, highlight products or architectural features, and provide comfortable conditions for customers and employees.

Custom-Made Furniture DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs custom furniture for commercial spaces, including reception desks, retail displays, shelving, cabinets, storage systems, workstations, conference tables, office kitchens, decorative wall panels, and other individual elements.
Detailed furniture drawings and technical specifications can be prepared for manufacturing.
Custom furniture production, delivery, and professional installation based on the developed project are also available.
Branding in Interior Design A commercial interior can become an extension of a company's visual identity.
Logos, signage, corporate colors, wayfinding systems, graphic elements, and decorative features can be integrated into the interior concept to create a recognizable brand environment.
Technical Documentation Depending on the scope of the project, we prepare technical documentation and working drawings required to implement the approved design concept.
The documentation provides a clear basis for coordination between contractors, furniture manufacturers, suppliers, and other specialists involved in the project.

Project Implementation Support Depending on the project, DUMSKAYA DESIGN can provide implementation support and coordinate design-related matters with contractors, suppliers, and furniture manufacturers.
This helps maintain the integrity of the original design concept throughout the different stages of project implementation.
Modern & Practical Solutions When designing commercial interiors, we consider relevant requirements for safety, accessibility, functionality, and the practical operation of each space.
Natural materials, energy-efficient lighting, and other solutions focused on responsible use of resources can also be incorporated according to the client's requirements.
Interior Design for Different Commercial Spaces We develop individual interior solutions for a wide range of businesses:
— offices and corporate spaces;
— retail stores and boutiques;
— beauty salons;
— barbershops;
— showrooms;
— dental and medical practices;
— restaurants and cafés;
— hotels and apartments;
— studios and service businesses;
— other commercial properties.
Every project is developed individually according to the business concept, characteristics of the property, and specific requirements of the client.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) — commercial interior design, 3D visualization, technical documentation, custom-made furniture, and comprehensive project solutions.
We create commercial spaces that work for your business.
